units.source_text: 但得如此，我便可尽力效劳了。”

en.t: If that can be arranged, I will be able to serve you with all my strength.

units.source_text: 大女公子想不到他会说这话，心中不快，默不作答。

en.t: The elder princess had not expected him to say such a thing; displeased at heart, she remained silent and gave no answer.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得这位大女公子没有神圣不可侵犯的模样，

en.t: Kaoru felt that this elder princess did not have the air of someone sacred and untouchable,

units.source_text: 但又不像时髦青年女子那样娇艳风骚，

en.t: yet she was also not coquettish and dazzling like fashionable young women,

units.source_text: 真是一位端详闲雅的淑女。

en.t: but truly a refined lady of calm dignity and quiet grace.

units.source_text: 他推量其人的模样，认为女子正该如此，才合乎自己的理想。

en.t: As he imagined what she must be like, he thought that a woman ought to be just this way, and only then would she match his own ideal.

units.source_text: 因此他常在言语得便之时隐约表示恋慕之情。

en.t: For that reason, whenever the conversation gave him an opening, he would often hint at his feelings of love and longing.

units.source_text: 但大女公子只管装作不知。

en.t: But the elder princess simply went on pretending not to notice.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得可耻，便转变话头，一本正经地续谈往昔的旧事。

en.t: Kaoru felt ashamed, so he changed the subject and continued speaking in earnest about old matters from the past.
